rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees renewing for the first time are exempt from CE.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; hours do not carry over to a later registration period.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses offered or approved by NBCC, ACA, AAMFT, NASW, ASWB, APA or affiliates, the CT Department of Education or DMHAS; graduate coursework or programs of regionally accredited institutions; first presentation (5 h) or peer-reviewed publication (6 h); face-to-face or home study with proficiency exam
rules.audit_note: Certificates must be submitted to the Department on request.

topics.who: First renewal period in which CE is required, then at least once every six years (veterans' mental health incl. suicide prevention)

rules.notes: License renewal due the last day of the birth month, annually. Max 12 contact hours per day; business-management topics max 3 hours. Keep certificates 3 years. Professional counselor associates have the same CE duty.
rules.legal_basis: Conn. Gen. Stat. §20-195cc; Regs. Conn. State Agencies §§20-195cc-1 to 20-195cc-7
